status: Cell-note implementation tested; parent issue remains open
delivered: Add, edit and delete standard XLSX cell notes through Tools and the cell context menu.
Cell indicators, hover cards, persistent always-show setting, previous/next navigation and sheet note list.
Preserve other note authors, rich-text runs, VML controls and unrelated package parts.
Hidden engine references keep note positions aligned with inserted/deleted rows and columns, Undo/Redo, repeated saving and reopening.
Read-only/protected sheet controls and refusal to overwrite a threaded discussion.
Labels in all nine enabled UI languages.

reproduction.after: The cell indicator and saved comment/VML references follow B2 to B3; Undo restores B2, Redo restores B3.
reproduction.before: The main-branch engine preserves a B2 note at B2 after inserting a row at index 1, leaving the note attached to the wrong cell.

limitations: Saving or deleting a note uses the existing package reload route and clears earlier editor undo history. The note window explicitly discloses this before saving.
Threaded comment editing/replies/resolution and note print modes remain outside this change. Issue #71 must remain open.
Clipboard transfer of notes between cells/workbooks is not implemented in this change.
The standard import warnings about protection writing and substituted fonts may remain visible; the GUI run has no page or console errors.
